name: AniTrack v1.0.9 - Interactive Episode Picker & Strict Airing Limit Guardrails
releaseNotes:
• Interactive 'Which episode are you on?' quick modal picker for Airing Schedule cards
• Direct 1-tap progress update with quick-jump episode grid and steppers
• Clean, streamlined Watchlist UI with instant filter chips and layout switchers
• Strict database and frontend guardrails preventing episode logging beyond latest broadcast
